reference: Alpaca, per side: no commission on stocks, ETFs and options; crypto charges 0.25 percent for an order that takes liquidity (rule crypto) and 0.15 percent for an order that adds it (rule crypto_maker), the first volume tier. Read from the fee schedule of the broker on 2026-11-22; not yet checked against a real statement. Regulatory fees on sales are not included, and the broker charges the crypto fee in the base currency on a buy: the table takes it on the trade value, which is the same amount.
source: Alpaca public crypto fee page (fee schedule read on 2026-11-22).
